items.q: In which phase of meiosis do homologous chromosomes pair up and crossing over occur?
items.qAf: In watter fase van meiose paar homoloë chromosome en vind kruisoorvleueling plaas?
items.explain: Homologous chromosomes pair and exchange segments during prophase I.
items.explainAf: Homoloë chromosome paar en ruil segmente tydens profase I uit.

items.q: A human body cell has 46 chromosomes. How many chromosomes are in a gamete?
items.qAf: ’n Menslike liggaamsel het 46 chromosome. Hoeveel chromosome is in ’n gameet?
items.explain: Meiosis halves the chromosome number, so the gamete has 23.
items.explainAf: Meiose halveer die chromosoomgetal, dus het die gameet 23.

items.q: How many daughter cells are produced from one primary spermatocyte after meiosis?
items.qAf: Hoeveel dogterselle word uit een primêre spermatosiet na meiose gevorm?
items.explain: Meiosis I and II together produce four haploid cells from one diploid cell.
items.explainAf: Meiose I en II saam lewer vier haploïede selle uit een diploïede sel.

items.q: Which process produces new combinations of alleles on the same pair of chromosomes?
items.qAf: Watter proses produseer nuwe kombinasies van allele op dieselfde paar chromosome?
items.explain: Crossing over exchanges alleles between homologous chromosomes, creating new combinations.
items.explainAf: Kruisoorvleueling ruil allele tussen homoloë chromosome uit en skep nuwe kombinasies.

items.q: How many different combinations of chromosomes can gametes have if n = 3 pairs of homologous chromosomes assort independently?
items.qAf: Hoeveel verskillende kombinasies van chromosome kan gamete hê as n = 3 pare homoloë chromosome onafhanklik sorteer?

items.q: Which TWO events together produce genetic variation in meiosis?
items.qAf: Watter TWEE gebeurtenisse saam veroorsaak genetiese variasie in meiose?
items.explain: Crossing over and independent assortment both create new allele combinations in gametes.
items.explainAf: Kruisoorvleueling en onafhanklike sortering skep albei nuwe allelkombinasies in gamete.

items.q: The exchange of genetic material between chromatids of homologous chromosomes.
items.qAf: Die uitruil van genetiese materiaal tussen chromatiede van homoloë chromosome.

items.q: A pair of chromosomes of the same size and shape, carrying genes for the same characteristics.
items.qAf: ’n Paar chromosome van dieselfde grootte en vorm wat gene vir dieselfde eienskappe dra.

items.q: The failure of chromosomes to separate properly during meiosis.
items.qAf: Die mislukking van chromosome om behoorlik tydens meiose te skei.

items.q: A cell with one set of chromosomes (n).

items.text: Crossing over takes place in [[]] I. In metaphase I the homologous pairs line up [[]] on the equator, which causes independent assortment.
items.textAf: Oorkruising vind in [[]] I plaas. In metafase I staan die homoloë pare [[]] op die ewenaar, wat onafhanklike sortering veroorsaak.

items.q: Meiosis produces four genetically different haploid cells.
items.qAf: Meiose lewer vier geneties verskillende haploïede selle.
items.explain: True. Crossing over and random arrangement make each gamete different.
items.explainAf: Waar. Oorkruising en lukrake rangskikking maak elke gameet anders.

items.q: The chromosome number is halved in meiosis II.
items.qAf: Die chromosoomgetal word in meiose II gehalveer.
items.explain: False. It is halved in meiosis I, when homologous chromosomes separate.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Dit word in meiose I gehalveer, wanneer homoloë chromosome skei.

items.q: Put the phases of meiosis I in order.
items.qAf: Rangskik die fases van meiose I in volgorde.

items.q: Explain why meiosis is important in sexual reproduction.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom meiose belangrik is in geslagtelike voortplanting.
points: It halves the chromosome number so that gametes are haploid.
At fertilisation the diploid number is restored, so it stays constant from generation to generation.
It produces genetic variation (crossing over, random arrangement).
pointsAf: Dit halveer die chromosoomgetal sodat gamete haploïed is.
By bevrugting word die diploïede getal herstel, dus bly dit konstant van geslag tot geslag.
Dit veroorsaak genetiese variasie (oorkruising, lukrake rangskikking).
